summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous, machine-checked formal verification and operationalization of OpenAI's Valiant coupling gadget, characteristic-2 permanent/Hamiltonian cycle dichotomies, Ryser inclusion-exclusion identities, and exact Cayley-orthogonal Boson-Sampling amplitudes. Utilizing an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (0 sorry) and a pure-stdlib zero-float verifier (PERM-HAM-CERT-1.0), the work establishes complete soundness across 16 exact-Q certificates and successfully repels 54 live adversarial red-teaming attacks.
weaknesses: Scope boundaries restrict larger sparse Valiant gadgets beyond MAX_N = 12 due to exponential growth of exact Ryser and Held-Karp replay complexity.
